 School holiday activity: drop-in summer storytime
 School holiday activity: drop-in summer storytime 
 As the Summer holidays draw to a close, join us for free drop-in storytelling sessions.
 Featuring funny and charming yarns from the Library’s extensive collection of children’s books, this activity is perfect for children aged 0 to 8 years and their families.
 Enjoy a selection of delightful stories, share in the magic of reading, and discover some new favourites along the way.
 Sessions daily from Wednesday 27 through to Friday 29 January.
 No bookings are required. Simply drop in and take part in reading stories at the Library.
